name: synthesis
description: Drug synthesis: cook reagents into potency-scaled drugs via a chemistry skill check + a 'stabilize the reaction' minigame. Raw→processed cooks require a real chem lab (station quality adds a bonus); no portable kit. A successful lab cook/splice deposits its finished product into the chem lab's shared storage vault (the lab furniture doubles as a container).

synthesize.note: The unambiguous drug-cooking verb. `cook` is owned by plugins/cooking and routes here via the `synthesis.cook` Action when the room/argument point at a chem lab; this is the escape hatch that always means drugs. The hub surfaces the 'cook' verb only.

splice.note: Master tier; requires a real chem-lab furniture + >=2 drug items + a Stabilizer. Not a specializedAction — surfaced as an action-link on chem-lab examine (furniture.describe hub) only once your Chemistry is high enough to splice.
